API Documentation

Introduction

Welcome to our API documentation. This guide will help you get started with our REST API.

Getting Started

To use our API, you need to obtain an API key from our developer portal.

curl -X GET "https://api.example.com/data" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

API Endpoints

GET /users

Retrieve a list of users.

ParameterTypeDescription
limitintegerMaximum number of results
offsetintegerNumber of results to skip

POST /users

Create a new user.
